title: Fee-Charging ERC4626 Vaults Create Phantom Surplus That Drains Earlier Depositors
rootCause: clientBalances tracks the pre-fee deposit amount (line 249), but vault shares reflect post-fee values. With multiple clients and a fee-charging vault, totalBalanceOf() uses proportional calculation (totalValue * principal / totalDeposited) which overstates later depositors' balances and creates phantom surplus. The contract's NatSpec claims compatibility with 'any ERC4626-compliant vault' but fee-on-deposit is a valid ERC4626 feature.
impact: With a 5% fee vault: Client A deposits 1000 (gets shares worth 950). Client B deposits 1000 (gets shares worth 950). Total shares worth 1900, totalDeposited=2000. Each client's totalBalanceOf = 950, but surplus calculation: 950 - 1000 = negative, clamped to 0. No surplus extractable until yield overcomes the fee deficit. Additionally, when clients withdraw principal, they receive less than deposited because shares are worth less than recorded principal.
recommendation: Track principal as vault.previewDeposit(amount) (post-fee effective amount) rather than the input amount. Or explicitly document fee-charging vaults as unsupported and add a constructor check.
